purchasing.supplierProducts.page.title: Supplier products
purchasing.supplierProducts.page.descrip: Each supplier’s goods list: code, Chinese/English names, customs data, unit, packing and unit weight, prices and photos. Prices are kept as kind × currency × minimum quantity.
purchasing.supplierProducts.list.searchP: Search by product SKU, supplier item no., or Chinese/English name
purchasing.supplierProducts.list.empty: No products for this supplier yet — add the first one
purchasing.supplierProducts.actions.prom: Create this item in the product master?

Creates or updates the product master record for this code and links the two — only then can the item be shipped and received. An existing product with the same SKU is updated, not duplicated. The supplier library keeps its own record.
purchasing.supplierProducts.promote.next: Product record ready for {name}. Shipping and stock receipt also need the product’s official catalog link.
Open the product and fill its official catalog link
purchasing.supplierProducts.actions.unli: Clear the link to this product?
The row goes back to an unlinked state: it can still be ordered, but it cannot be shipped or received until it is linked again. Purchase orders already placed keep their own record.
purchasing.supplierProducts.actions.sync: Push this row’s values to the product?

Writes this row’s non-empty values (names, spec, HS code, unit, weight, size, Qty/Box) and its supplier cost price onto the linked product. The official catalog link, the internal/export prices and the variants are not touched.
purchasing.supplierProducts.link.title: Link to an existing product
purchasing.supplierProducts.link.descrip: Pick the product master record this supplier item is the supplier’s version of. Only the link is written — the product’s fields and prices stay as they are.
purchasing.supplierProducts.link.empty: No product matches. Create the product record first, then link it.
purchasing.supplierProducts.link.loadFai: Could not load the product master.
purchasing.supplierProducts.link.forbidd: Your role cannot read the product master (products.items.view), so there is nothing to pick here.
purchasing.supplierProducts.syncFields.n: The product already matches this row — nothing to write
purchasing.supplierProducts.actions.dele: The row is soft-deleted and the code stays reserved until it is restored. Purchase orders that already reference it keep their snapshot.
purchasing.supplierProducts.promote.skip: Already has a product record — nothing to do
purchasing.supplierProducts.promote.fail: Could not create the product record

purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.su: Our code for this item: unique within the supplier, written into the product master’s SKU when a product record is created, and never reused — including by a deleted row.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.na: The supplier’s own product name, transcribed as printed. Syncing does not overwrite our Chinese name with it.
Our own Chinese name; becomes the product master’s name when the row is synced.
Our own English name; used on export documents and written to the master’s English name.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.hs: Harmonized System Code — stored as text so leading zeros and dotted groups (8471.30.0000) survive. Do not treat it as a number.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.de: Declaration elements (name, brand, model, material, use, spec…), copied verbatim onto customs paperwork.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.un: Options come from the supplier_product_unit dictionary (maintained under Dictionaries); a code it does not list can still be typed.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.mo: Minimum Order Quantity — the smallest quantity the supplier will take.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.ca: Quantity per box — how many units a carton holds; shipment allocation converts through it.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.un: Net weight of one unit, packaging excluded — the N.W. column on the supplier’s sheet, in kg. Optional.
Gross weight of one unit including its packaging — the G.W. column on the supplier’s sheet, in kg. Optional.
Volume of one unit in cm³, as the supplier prints it. Optional; not derived from the product size.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.it: The number printed on the supplier’s own sheet; both stay visible when they differ.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.de: The supplier’s own spec text; becomes the master’s spec summary on sync.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.no: Internal note; never printed on a document.

purchasing.supplierProducts.price.title: Prices
purchasing.supplierProducts.price.hint: One supply price per item: the price the supplier charges us, in its own currency. The discount below is this item’s rate and the net amount is derived. Our own offer is maintained on the product record (internal settlement price), so it is not entered here. Clearing the amount means no supply price — the old price is deactivated, never deleted.
purchasing.supplierProducts.price.empty: No supply price yet — type the amount the supplier quoted.
purchasing.supplierProducts.price.help.u: The supplier’s price for one unit, before the discount.
purchasing.supplierProducts.price.help.d: The supplier’s discount off this item’s supply price — a whole number of percent (0–100; blank = none). The net amount is derived — it is what the product record receives as its cost price.
purchasing.supplierProducts.price.netNee: Enter the unit price to see the net amount.
purchasing.supplierProducts.price.others: Another currency or ladder step, a withdrawn price, or a legacy offer row. Kept for traceability and submitted back unchanged.
purchasing.suppliers.form.help.brandValu: Options come from the product_brand dictionary (maintained under Dictionaries): the brand abbreviation this supplier’s goods are sold under, used as the code prefix when the supplier product library generates a code, and overridable on a row. Add a brand the list does not carry under Dictionaries first.
purchasing.suppliers.form.help.code: Issued automatically when the supplier is created.
purchasing.supplierProducts.form.help.br: The brand this row’s codes are generated under; blank falls back to the supplier’s default brand.
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.brandIn: Blank uses the supplier’s default brand: {brand}
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.brandMi: Pick a brand in “Brand (code prefix)” above, or set a default brand on the supplier, before generating a code.
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.categor: No categories are available: add one to the product_category dictionary, or reload the page.
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.legacyH: No rule matches it: a legacy code, kept as it is.
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.partial: The segments marked unregistered are not in their code list; the reading is inferred from the rule shape.
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.generat: The code could not be generated
purchasing.supplierProducts.code.editabl: Generate only fills a starting value into “Product SKU”; edit it freely — a code no rule describes is still typed by hand.
